Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  Real.log_lt_log
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
      (lt_of_lt_of_le
        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_lt_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl false))
        hX))
    (sqrt_lt_floor hX).left
 has type
  Real.log √(↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁)) < Real.log ↑⌊↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁)⌋₊
but is expected to have type
  δ * ↑r₁ * Real.log ↑q₁ / 2 < Real.log ↑⌊↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁)⌋₊
'Log239Inline.three_small_factors' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Log239Inline.main_lemma' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
